name: agentic-protocol
description: Goal-directed project memory: a short goal/state map and dated work logs loaded on demand. No index, database or MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Project memory in plain markdown. No index, no daemon, no MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Keep goals, current conclusions and coarse milestones in .agent-context/PROGRESS.md; preserve detailed evidence in worklog/YYYY-MM-DD.md. New sessions resume from the state map and follow task links only when needed, not by calendar date; there is no separate handoff to maintain. Supporting project knowledge is loaded on demand. Ships bootstrap-context, update-progress and run-review skills and bounded SessionStart protocol delivery for Codex. Hooks use Python standard library only; one source serves Cursor, Codex and CodeBuddy.
defaultPrompt: Update the work record and current conclusions
What is the current task state?
